study: 2025 Kyodo days1-2 fixed H1-H4 plus provisional H5 cumulative relation cut

definition.h_order: H1 -> H2 -> H3 -> H4 -> provisional H5; removed pairs never re-enter
definition.provisional_h5_history_relation: After H1-H4, count how many ACTUAL H1-H4 cut-center pairs each rider belonged to. For each H4-surviving wide pair, relation_score is the sum of its two riders' touch counts. Cut highest relation_score first until 5 remain; ties cut higher pre-race joint co-top3 probability first.
definition.provisional_h5: PRIOR FAILED COMPARISON ONLY: From H4 survivors, choose two unordered 3-rider joint504 scenarios sharing two riders.
definition.board: v3.2 forward board, calibrated only on prior data
definition.base_tickets: all unique wide pairs among riders appearing anywhere on the 7-piece board
definition.strongest_two: top two riders by model top3 inclusion probability = P1+P2+P3 from joint504
definition.cut: remove exactly that strongest-two wide pair if it exists in base tickets
